text:
zoe: urgent: a handful of customers reported unexpected billing jumps after the implicit v2 preference rolled out overnight. We need a concise emergency UX + API for quick pin + audit.
michael: +1. saw 5 tenants hit high token velocity. suggest a "panic pin" that SREs can apply from the console or CLI with minimal friction.
anya: safety checks: panic pin should prefill reason, default ttl=8h, and require role pin:emergency. also record pin_provenance and emit telemetry immediately.
ops-bot: auto: alert annotated: tenants=5, avg_token_increase=27%, top_routes=background-embed-worker
carter: UX: panic pin button should be hidden behind a small dropdown to avoid accidental clicks. After click show an inline toast with audit id and link to runbook. No modal.
pm-beth: product: we need to show estimated impact before and after pin in the banner. Add a small sparkline of projected token savings and a confidence score.
michael: runtime nuance: pin won't affect existing worker connections until drain; show connection_drain_seconds and show a "flush-affinity (opt-in)" checkbox that warns about latency.
anya: telemetry payload to emit on pin: event_type=pin_applied, pin_actor, pin_scope, ttl, projected_savings, pre_pin_tokens, post_pin_tokens_estimate, connection_drain_seconds. Keep retention 90d.
carter: API sketch (CLI friendly): curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/pins -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"tenant":"acme","version":"v1","ttl":"8h","reason":"panic-billing-spike","actor":"zoe"}'
ops-bot: auto: follow-up scheduled in 30m.
pm-beth: action owners: carter->UI quick-button + toast; michael->drain visibility + flush option; anya->telemetry schema + RBAC; zoe->runbook snippet & comms to billing ops. We'll gate panic pin behind a feature flag for 24h while we validate.
